description: MUST-FAIL: float inside an array. jcs-n validation MUST recurse into array elements; delegating arrays to json.dumps bypasses numeric validation entirely. Regression vector for the array-bypass bug (Fix 1, round 2: _jcs lacked a list branch and fell through to json.dumps, silently accepting floats/unsafe-ints/>=1e21 nested in lists).
note: The float 1.5 is nested inside an array. A conforming implementation MUST signal an error rather than serialize it. An implementation that delegates arrays to json.dumps will silently produce a digest, violating the spec.
